title: Ordinary sections and the normalized strict section fibre
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $U$. Let $\mathcal M$ be the internal-module category of the pulled-back continuous integral coefficient ring [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. Define $\Gamma:\mathcal M\to\mathbf{Ab}$ by forgetting the action and evaluating the underlying sheaf at the identity pro-etale object. Put $R\Gamma=\Gamma^{\mathrm{right\ derived}}$. For a cochain complex $I$ of strict inverse systems in $\mathcal M$, let $\Gamma^{\mathrm{Tow}}I$ be termwise sections and define $\lambda_I:\Gamma(\lim I)\to\operatorname{Roos}(\Gamma^{\mathrm{Tow}}I)$ by the strict Roos augmentation [def-weil-strict-roos-model] of the family $\Gamma(\lim I\to I_n)$, with zero nullhomotopy. The definitions are ordinary, uncompleted sections, and the index $n$ represents exponent $n+1$.
